interface.signature: def find_screen_height(width: int, ratio: str) -> str:

preconditions.description: The width must be a positive integer.
The ratio string must contain exactly one colon separating width and height components.
Both parts of the ratio string must be non-negative integers.
The height component of the ratio must be positive to avoid division by zero.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a string.
The output string must contain exactly one 'x' separator.
The width part of the output string must match the input width.
The height part of the output string must be calculated by scaling the input width by the ratio (height/width) using integer division.
